teaser: What the bitcoin bounty actually proves: the real timeline, whether a firewall could have caught it, and hardening without the patch.
core_idea: A won bitcoin bounty is real, independent proof that php2shell gives full command execution, but the headline 19.28 hours mostly measures a target with no attackable page; the real build time was about three hours once one existed. Vendor WAF and IDS coverage exists but each vendor names its own gap, and every public hardening measure, tested seriously by GrapheneOS, is described as partial by its own authors; patching remains the only complete fix.
